description.en:
Book a merchant haulier to collect grain directly from your on-farm silos. A truck spawns at your chosen merchant arrival point, drives to the silo, loads, drives to the best-paying buyer, sells, and despawns. Multi-trip for large silos.
REQUIRES AUTODRIVE — this mod uses your AutoDrive waypoint network for routing. Without AutoDrive installed and a waypoint network drawn on your map, the haulier cannot dispatch.
How it works: - Press F7 to open the Produce Collection tab. One row per grain you own, sortable by price / best buyer / best month. - Click any row's BOOK button to dispatch the merchant. On first use you'll be asked to pick a merchant arrival point from your AutoDrive markers — choose an open spot with room for the truck to spawn and turn. - The merchant truck (vanilla Lizard MultiPurpose, extended cargo) handles the round trip on autopilot. Grain transfer is instant on arrival at each end — see the README for why. - Money lands when the truck reaches the buyer. Repeat trips run automatically until the silo is empty.
Vehicle selection (small / large / tractor + trailer) planned for v0.7.
